title: Equity premium forecast with a Gaussian process
description: Next-month US equity return from the term spread, Baa spread, VIX and NFCI with a Matern GP (small n).
question: forecasting
method_note: Welch-Goyal (2008) showed most equity-premium predictors fail out of sample. A GP is a flexible Bayesian regression whose predictive sd widens where data are sparse (e.g. VIX spikes); walk-forward CV and a CRPS DM test against a linear-Gaussian baseline keep it honest. n is about 350, well under the O(n^3) cap. Caveat: the universe is today's constituents (membership history starts 2026-10), so early years carry survivorship bias; read the premium as an upper bound.

result.verdict: GP is worse than linear-Gaussian baseline on CRPS (mean 0.02827 vs 0.02797); point forecast: GP is worse than linear baseline out of sample (mean loss 0.002668 vs 0.002615)

study.name: Equity premium forecast with a Gaussian process
